newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Alaska upgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Alaska upgraded to hold.

text.p: Alaska Milk Corp has been upgraded to a hold from sell by Angping Securities due to declining skimmed milk prices in the world market.

In an advisory to clients on Friday, analyst Georgina Antonino said she expects skimmed milk world prices to stabilise at slightly below $2,000 per tonne in the short-term from previous levels of around $2,400 due to the increased subsidies from Europe and Australia.
"Effects of this on margins (for Alaska), however, are expected to be felt in the long term as the company's average cost of inventory is still pegged at $2,300 per tonne," she said.
Nevertheless, the declining prices of milk, which account for 50 percent of Alaska's production costs, would give the company the opportuntiy to recover, she said.

At its closing price of 1.96 pesos on Friday, Angping Securities said the stock has a price-earnings ratio of 11.5 and 7.8 times forecast 1996 and 1997 earnings per share of 0.17 peso and 0.25 peso respectively.
